headline: Komyshuvakha aid-site toll revised 31 -> 33 killed
dek: Zelenskyy said at least 33 people were killed on Monday Nov 2 when Russia twice bombed the school being used for aid distribution in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region — revising the toll recorded at 0500-03 (31 killed, 45+ missing, via regional authorities/ET/NIE). Discrepancy noted, not smoothed:…
sources: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy statement, via Reuters; Japan Times relay
fault_line: Aid site or military target? Moscow frames Komyshuvakha as a troop concentration; Kyiv and the toll count frame it as a double-tap on civilians queuing for aid.

sections.what_happened: Zelenskyy said at least 33 people were killed on Monday Nov 2 when Russia twice bombed the school being used for aid distribution in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region — revising the toll recorded at 0500-03 (31 killed, 45+ missing, via regional authorities/ET/NIE). Discrepancy noted, not smoothed: 29 (Nov 3 regional) -> 31 (Nov 3 regional/ET/NIE) -> 33 (Zelenskyy via Reuters). Same barrage context already recorded: 289 drones + 17 ballistic + 59 cruise missiles overnight Nov 2-3; DTEK says three of its five thermal power plants knocked offline in the wider Nov 3 energy barrage.
sections.what_disputed: Russia's Defence Ministry said its Nov 3 strikes targeted Ukrainian military units around Komyshuvakha and two other Zaporizhzhia settlements, claiming up to 25 Ukrainian servicemen killed — a different casualty frame (military vs civilian aid-site toll) that does not reconcile with the 33 civilian toll.
sections.why_matters: Toll correction only — not a new strike video. Carries forward the recorded discrepancy (31 regional vs 33 presidential) for any future Komyshuvakha reference.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Zelenskyy statement Nov 3, via Reuters Nov 3; Japan Times Nov 4): Komyshuvakha aid-site toll revised 31 -> 33 killed
